name: base
description: Pure, total operations and the control-flow components every UI must implement, for port validators, effects, blok util calls and blok trees. Argument order is positional order. Additive evolution only.

operations.name: eq
operations.description: True if a equals b (deep JSON equality).

operations.name: ne
operations.description: True if a does not equal b (deep JSON equality).

operations.name: gt
operations.description: True if a > b. Non-numbers compare false.

operations.name: gte
operations.description: True if a >= b. Non-numbers compare false.

operations.name: lt
operations.description: True if a < b. Non-numbers compare false.

operations.name: lte
operations.description: True if a <= b. Non-numbers compare false.

operations.name: between
operations.description: True if min <= value <= max (inclusive). Non-numbers compare false.

operations.name: and
operations.description: Logical conjunction of two booleans. Nest calls for more operands.

operations.name: or
operations.description: Logical disjunction of two booleans. Nest calls for more operands.

operations.name: not
operations.description: Logical negation.

operations.name: if
operations.description: Returns then if condition is true, otherwise otherwise.

operations.name: is_null
operations.description: True if a is null or missing.

operations.name: is_set
operations.description: True if a is neither null nor missing.

operations.name: len
operations.description: Length of a string, list or dict. Null counts as 0.

operations.name: len_between
operations.description: True if min <= len(value) <= max (inclusive). Omit max for no upper bound.

operations.name: is_empty
operations.description: True if a is null or has length 0.

operations.name: contains
operations.description: True if haystack contains needle: substring for strings, membership for lists, key presence for dicts.

arguments.description: The element or substring to look for.

operations.name: in
operations.description: True if value is a member of options.

operations.name: matches
operations.description: True if the whole of value matches the regular expression pattern.

arguments.description: A regular expression (ECMAScript and Python common subset).

operations.name: starts_with
operations.description: True if value starts with prefix.

operations.name: ends_with
operations.description: True if value ends with suffix.

operations.name: get
operations.description: Reads path (a JSON pointer) out of value; null when the path does not resolve.

operations.name: coalesce
operations.description: The first of a, b that is not null.

operations.name: add
operations.description: a + b. Non-numbers yield null.

operations.name: sub
operations.description: a - b. Non-numbers yield null.

operations.name: mul
operations.description: a * b. Non-numbers yield null.

operations.name: div
operations.description: a / b (float division). Non-numbers and division by zero yield null.

operations.name: mod
operations.description: a modulo b, with the sign of the divisor (Python semantics). Non-numbers and a zero divisor yield null.

operations.name: neg
operations.description: -a. Non-numbers yield null.

operations.name: fmt.bytes
operations.description: Formats a byte count with a unit suffix.

operations.name: fmt.currency
operations.description: Formats a number as a currency amount.

operations.name: fmt.date
operations.description: Formats a date for the viewer locale.

operations.name: fmt.datetime
operations.description: Formats a date and time for the viewer locale.

operations.name: fmt.json
operations.description: Renders any value as JSON.

arguments.description: Spaces to indent by; none prints one line.

operations.name: fmt.number
operations.description: Formats a number for the viewer locale.

arguments.description: At least this many fraction digits.
At most this many fraction digits.

operations.name: fmt.percent
operations.description: Formats a 0–1 ratio as a percentage.

operations.name: fmt.relativeTime
operations.description: Formats a date relative to now ("3 hours ago").

operations.name: list.at
operations.description: The item at an index. Negative indexes count from the end.

arguments.description: Position; negative counts from the end.

operations.name: list.compact
operations.description: Removes null and undefined items from a list.

operations.name: list.first
operations.description: The first item of a list.

operations.name: list.join
operations.description: Joins a list into a string.

operations.name: list.last
operations.description: The last item of a list.

operations.name: list.pluck
operations.description: Reads the same path out of every item in a list.

arguments.description: A path inside each item (a/b or a.b).

operations.name: list.range
operations.description: The numbers start, start + step, … : count of them (at most 10000). What a foreach iterates when there is no list.

operations.name: list.reverse
operations.description: Reverses a list.

operations.name: list.slice
operations.description: Takes a section of a list.

operations.name: list.sort
operations.description: Sorts a list, optionally by a path on each item.

arguments.description: A path inside each item (a/b or a.b).

operations.name: list.sum
operations.description: Adds up the numbers in a list.

operations.name: list.unique
operations.description: Removes duplicate items from a list.

operations.name: math.abs
operations.description: Absolute value of a number.

operations.name: math.ceil
operations.description: Rounds a number up.

operations.name: math.clamp
operations.description: Constrains a number to an inclusive range.

operations.name: math.floor
operations.description: Rounds a number down.

operations.name: math.round
operations.description: Rounds a number to the given number of decimal places.

operations.name: obj.entries
operations.description: An object as a list of {key, value} records, ready for foreach.

operations.name: obj.has
operations.description: True when a nested path resolves to a value.

arguments.description: A path inside each item (a/b or a.b).

operations.name: obj.keys
operations.description: The keys of an object.

operations.name: obj.values
operations.description: The values of an object.

operations.name: str.capitalize
operations.description: Uppercases the first character.

operations.name: str.default
operations.description: Falls back to another string when the value is empty.

arguments.description: What to answer when there is no usable value.

operations.name: str.lower
operations.description: Lowercases a string.

operations.name: str.replace
operations.description: Replaces every occurrence of a substring.

operations.name: str.slice
operations.description: Extracts part of a string by character index.

operations.name: str.split
operations.description: Splits a string into a list on a separator.

operations.name: str.trim
operations.description: Removes surrounding whitespace.

operations.name: str.truncate
operations.description: Shortens a string to a maximum length, adding an ellipsis.

arguments.description: Appended when cut. Defaults to an ellipsis.

operations.name: str.upper
operations.description: Uppercases a string.

operations.name: type.of
operations.description: Names the type of a value: null, list, object, string, number, or boolean.

operations.name: type.toBoolean
operations.description: Converts a value to a boolean, treating "false" and "0" as false.

operations.name: type.toNumber
operations.description: Converts a value to a number, or falls back when it cannot.

arguments.description: What to answer when there is no usable value.

operations.name: type.toString
operations.description: Converts any value to a string.

components.name: case
components.description: One branch of a `match`: its children render when the matched value is `is`.

props.description: The literal this case matches, or a list of them. A literal: it is read off the blok, not resolved.

components.name: default
components.description: The branch of a `match` that renders when no `case` matches.

components.name: empty
components.description: Renders its children when a read answered with nothing: no rows, every field empty.

props.description: The record to follow: a read bound with `bind` (`@cells`) or a run bound with `.into(job)` (`@job`). Inside a `query` it defaults to the query's.

components.name: failed
components.description: Renders its children when a read (or a run) failed. The reason is `<record>.error`.

props.description: The record to follow: a read bound with `bind` (`@cells`) or a run bound with `.into(job)` (`@job`). Inside a `query` it defaults to the query's.

components.name: foreach
components.description: Renders its declared children once per item of a list.

props.description: The list to iterate. Bind it to a data-model path to make it writable.
Scope name each item is addressable by inside the loop body.

components.name: fragment
components.description: Renders its children without introducing an element.

props.description: Ids of child components to render here.

components.name: if
components.description: Renders one of two children depending on a condition.

props.description: Rendered when it does not.
Rendered when the condition holds.
Condition. Bind it to a path or compute it with a pure util call.

components.name: match
components.description: Renders the first `case` child whose `is` names the value, else its `default` child. The way to compare against several values, since a blok expression has no `==`.

props.description: The value to match, typically a path: `@job.status`.

components.name: pending
components.description: Renders its children while a read (or a run) is under way and there is no earlier answer to show.

props.description: The record to follow: a read bound with `bind` (`@cells`) or a run bound with `.into(job)` (`@job`). Inside a `query` it defaults to the query's.

components.name: query
components.description: Runs a GraphQL query (reads only, never a mutation) against one service and writes its record under `bind`. Renders its children always; the record slots inside it (`pending`, `failed`, `empty`, `ready`) follow its record.

props.description: Where the record is written: {"status", "loading", "ready", "failed", "empty", "stale", "error", "data"}. `data` is the query's answer, typed by its selection when the validator knows the schema. The validator seeds an idle record in demo_state; a preview, which runs no query, shows what demo_state holds there.
Remove the record when this query leaves the screen, instead of keeping it marked stale.
Ask again every this many seconds while the blok is open.

The GraphQL query, run on the `schema` service: one `query` operation, never a mutation or subscription (a change goes through an action). Each variable it declares is read from `variables`, else from the data path of the same name; a structure held there is passed as its id. The query waits for every variable declared non-null.
The service whose schema `query` is written against, and which runs it, by its key: "mikro". A validator that knows the service type-checks the query and what the blok reads of its answer.
Values for the variables `query` declares, ahead of the data paths of the same name.

components.name: ready
components.description: Renders its children once a read answered with something (or a run is done), including while a newer read refreshes it.

props.description: The record to follow: a read bound with `bind` (`@cells`) or a run bound with `.into(job)` (`@job`). Inside a `query` it defaults to the query's.

components.name: when
components.description: Renders its declared children while a condition holds: an `if` without naming the children by id.

props.description: Render when the condition does NOT hold.
Condition. Bind it to a path (`@cells.ready`) or compute it with a pure util call (`@utils.gt(count, 0)`).
